scripts.dev: npm run build -w @splash/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @splash/shared" "npm run dev -w @splash/server" "npm run dev -w @splash/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @splash/shared && npm run build -w @splash/server && npm run build -w @splash/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client
